use_cases.name: Analyse representation, pay and progression with privacy thresholds and track actions
use_cases.goal: Give authorised HR users diversity, equity and inclusion metrics by permitted attributes, protected by minimum group sizes, and track the actions taken in response.

stakeholders.interest: Self-declared attributes are used only for permitted aggregate analysis and never identify an individual.
Sees credible trends across sites and commits owners to measurable actions.
Controls which attributes are permitted and who may analyse them.
Can verify that suppression rules were applied to every published figure.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations opens the inclusion analytics workspace or a quarterly review pack is generated.
preconditions: Permitted attributes such as gender, age band and self-declared disability are configured by the tenant admin, with consent recorded where required under the DPDP Act 2023 (to be validated by Legal).
The minimum group size is configured, for example 10 people per reported cell.
People, compensation and promotion analytics projections are refreshed within the last 24 hours.
postconditions_success: Published metrics show only cells meeting the minimum group size, with suppression shown explicitly.
Each action has an owner, target metric, due date and status, reviewed each quarter.
postconditions_failure: A query that would expose a small group returns a suppression notice rather than a figure.

main_flow.action: Selects representation by gender for grade bands across Chakan, Peenya, Oragadam and Medchal Works and the Pune office.
Reads the analytics projections limited to the user's grant and to permitted attributes only.
Applies the minimum group size and complementary suppression so that hidden cells cannot be derived from totals.
Shows representation, hiring, promotion rate and median pay gap per grade band with trend over 8 quarters.
Drills from entity to site and grade band; each drill re-applies the thresholds.
Creates an action, for example raise women's share of shift supervisors at Medchal Works from 6% to 12% by 2027-12-31.
Approves the action with owner and budget through the approval engine.
Tracks the target metric each quarter and shows progress on the action card.

alternate_flows.condition: A manager opens inclusion metrics for their own team.
steps: Platform shows only metrics where the team meets the minimum group size; otherwise it shows the site-level figure.

exception_flows.condition: A cell has 7 people against a minimum of 10.
exception_flows.handling: The cell is suppressed and one further cell is suppressed so the value cannot be derived from the total.

exception_flows.condition: The user tries to select an attribute not permitted by the tenant.
exception_flows.handling: The attribute is not offered and the attempt is recorded.

exception_flows.condition: A filter combination would identify one person.
exception_flows.handling: The query returns a suppression notice and no figure.

nfrs: No export, chart or agent response bypasses the minimum group size.
Every figure records the projection version so a quarter's pack can be reproduced.

user_stories.want: representation and promotion rates by site and grade with small groups hidden
user_stories.so_that: I can see real patterns without exposing anyone

acceptance.given: the minimum group size is 10 and women in grade band M at Medchal Works number 7
acceptance.when: I view representation by site and grade
acceptance.then: that cell shows Suppressed and the derivable neighbour cell is also suppressed

acceptance.given: promotion data for Chakan Works covers 140 eligible employees
acceptance.when: I view promotion rates by gender
acceptance.then: rates are shown with group sizes and the 8-quarter trend

user_stories.want: each inclusion action tied to a metric with an owner and date
user_stories.so_that: commitments are tracked rather than forgotten

acceptance.given: an action targets 12% women shift supervisors at Medchal Works by 2027-12-31 from 6%
acceptance.when: the Q1 2027 metric is computed at 8%
acceptance.then: the action card shows 8% against the 12% target

acceptance.given: an action passes its due date unmet
acceptance.then: it is flagged overdue to its owner and to me

user_stories.want: to confirm suppression was applied to a published pack
user_stories.so_that: I can attest that the analysis protected individuals

acceptance.then: every suppressed cell is listed with the rule applied

acceptance.given: I re-run the pack against its recorded projection version
acceptance.then: the figures match the published pack

use_cases.name: Recognise birthdays, work anniversaries and milestones automatically
use_cases.goal: Detect celebrations each day, prompt managers and peers to send messages, and publish them only for employees who have not opted out.

stakeholders.interest: Is celebrated without having to tell anyone, and can opt out of any or all celebrations.
Is reminded in time to wish team members, including those on night shifts.
Builds a culture of recognition across five sites with no manual tracking.

use_cases.trigger: The daily celebrations job runs at 06:00 IST.
preconditions: Dates of birth, joining dates and milestone definitions such as probation confirmation and service years 1, 5, 10 and 20 are configured.
Each employee's celebration preferences are recorded, defaulting to the tenant setting.
postconditions_success: Celebrations for opted-in employees are published to the feed and site screens, and managers have been prompted.
postconditions_failure: No celebration is produced for an employee who has opted out.

main_flow.action: Finds today's birthdays, service anniversaries and milestones for every active employee.
Removes employees who have opted out of that celebration type.
Sends each manager a list of team celebrations with a one-tap message option, 1 day ahead for night-shift staff.
Sends a personal message; it is delivered to the employee in the app and on the business messaging channel if opted in.
Posts a celebration card to the site feed showing name, photo if consented and the occasion, never the age or year of birth.
Peers add wishes to the card; messages pass the feed's moderation filter.
Shows the day's opted-in celebrations on the canteen display screens at each plant.

alternate_flows.condition: The anniversary is 10 or more years.
steps: Platform also notifies HR to arrange the long-service award.

exception_flows.condition: The employee has opted out of birthday announcements.
exception_flows.handling: No birthday card or manager prompt is generated for that employee.
It is held for HR review and not shown on the card.

exception_flows.condition: The date of birth is missing.
exception_flows.handling: No birthday is generated and no date is assumed.

nfrs: The daily job completes for 3,000 employees within 2 minutes.
An opt-out takes effect from the next daily run.

user_stories.want: to opt out of birthday announcements but keep work anniversaries
user_stories.so_that: I control what is shared about me

acceptance.given: E1032 has opted out of birthdays and kept anniversaries
acceptance.then: no card or manager prompt is generated
an anniversary card is posted and his manager is prompted

user_stories.want: to be reminded of my team's celebrations a day early for night-shift staff
user_stories.so_that: I can wish them before their shift

acceptance.given: E1066 works shift C 22:00–06:00 and her birthday is 2026-11-20
acceptance.then: I receive the reminder that day

acceptance.given: I tap send on the suggested message
acceptance.then: E1066 receives it in the app

use_cases.name: Run a targeted multilingual safety campaign with acknowledgement tracking
use_cases.goal: Deliver a policy or safety communication to a targeted audience in their languages across channels and track acknowledgement to completion.

stakeholders.interest: Receives safety instructions in a language they read, on a channel they use.
Knows which workers on each shift have not yet acknowledged.
Has acknowledgement evidence for each site.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations launches a campaign, for example monsoon electrical safety for production workers.
preconditions: The audience can be defined by site, department, shift and worker type.
Reviewers are named for each campaign language.
Channel opt-ins for the business messaging channel are recorded.
postconditions_success: Each recipient's acknowledgement status, channel and timestamp is recorded and exportable as site evidence.
postconditions_failure: Recipients not reached by the due date are escalated to their supervisors.

main_flow.action: Creates the campaign Monsoon electrical safety for production workers at Chakan and Oragadam Works, due in 7 days.
Drafts Marathi, Tamil and Hindi versions from the English text as proposals.
Sends each version to its reviewer; only approved versions are released.
Delivers to each worker in the preferred language through the app, the business messaging channel if opted in and the kiosk.
Reads the message and acknowledges with one tap.
Sends reminders on day 3 and day 6 to those who have not acknowledged.
Records bulk acknowledgement for workers briefed in a toolbox talk, with the attendance sheet attached.
Sees unacknowledged team members per shift and follows up.
Closes the campaign on the due date and produces the acknowledgement evidence by site.

alternate_flows.condition: The campaign is a policy update that also needs a quiz.
steps: Platform attaches a 3-question check and records acknowledgement only on a passing answer.

exception_flows.condition: A language version is not approved by launch time.
exception_flows.handling: Recipients of that language receive the Hindi version with a notice that their language follows.

exception_flows.condition: A worker has no app, no messaging opt-in and no kiosk use in 30 days.
exception_flows.handling: The worker is listed for supervisor briefing.

exception_flows.condition: Recipients remain unacknowledged at the due date.
exception_flows.handling: They are escalated to their supervisors and Plant HR with the list.

nfrs: Delivery to 2,500 recipients across channels completes within 10 minutes.
Acknowledgement evidence is retained for the period set by the compliance retention policy.

user_stories.want: to target a safety message by site, shift and language and see acknowledgement live
user_stories.so_that: I know the instruction reached everyone on the floor

acceptance.given: the campaign targets 1,180 production workers at Chakan and Oragadam Works
acceptance.then: each worker receives the approved version in their preferred language
I see 79.7% acknowledged with a breakdown by site and shift

user_stories.want: to record acknowledgement for workers briefed in a toolbox talk
user_stories.so_that: workers without phones are still covered

acceptance.given: 32 workers on shift B at Oragadam Works attended the toolbox talk
acceptance.when: I record bulk acknowledgement with the attendance sheet
acceptance.then: all 32 show acknowledged with channel Toolbox talk

acceptance.given: the attendance sheet lists 33 workers and one is not in the campaign audience
acceptance.then: that worker is rejected with a reason and the other 32 are recorded
